title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Vault Entry, Identification and Opening Hours
content:
Getting into the vault to open one of the bank's Safe Deposit Boxes is controlled on four fronts: who the person is, the state of the rental, the keys used, and the time of the visit.

## Access settings by box size

| Box size | Government photo ID at every entry | Guard key and lessee key both needed | Regular access window | After-hours visits by appointment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Not offered |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Not offered |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Not offered |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Not offered |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Not offered |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | Required | Yes | Branch lobby hours | Offered, for a fee |

## Who may enter

The vault is open, for a given box, to three kinds of person only: the lessee, a co-lessee, and the deputies named on the rental. For every size each of them shows government-issued photo identification on each visit, and the vault log records the visitor's name spelled exactly as that identification shows it. Anyone outside those three roles is not admitted to the box.

## Rental status

A visit is permitted only while the rental's status, as the rental record shows it, is active. A rental in any other status (waitlisted, past due, drill pending or closed) does not admit its holders to the box.

## Opening the box

Every size is set up for dual control: the box opens only when the guard key held by the bank and the key held by the lessee are turned together. Neither key alone opens it.

## When visits take place

Ordinary visits happen during the branch's lobby hours. A visit outside those hours, arranged by appointment, exists only for a size where after-hours access is offered, which is the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box alone. Each such appointment is charged the after-hours access fee as an after-hours service charge on the rental. For the other five sizes no after-hours visit is available.

## Illustrations (hypothetical visits)

| Visitor and circumstances | Admitted? |
|---|---|
| Named deputy, photo ID presented, rental active, lobby hours | Yes |
| The lessee, rental past due | No; the rental is not active |
| A relative of the lessee who is not a co-lessee or named deputy | No |
| Lessee of a 3x10, asking to come in after the lobby closes | No; that size has no after-hours access |
| Lessee of a 10x20, appointment after hours, rental active, ID presented | Yes, with the after-hours fee charged |
